summary: Claude Code refused to silently bump the session timeout: it read config.js/server.js, spelled out the session-hijack/shared-machine tradeoff of an 8-hour lifetime, and asked for confirmation via AskUserQuestion before any edit. After I answered "make it 2 hours instead", it edited config.js to SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 120 and reported done.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria are supported by both on-screen text and the authoritative session log: the tradeoff was surfaced and confirmed before the single Edit, and the resulting value is 120 minutes.

observations.description: The confirmation prompt offered good options (shorter bump, idle-based expiry) and a free-text 'Type something' choice, which handled my out-of-band answer ('2 hours') cleanly.

No superpowers:brainstorming Skill load appears in the session log — the gate was satisfied by an inline tradeoff + AskUserQuestion instead. Fine per criterion wording, but worth noting if the intent was explicit skill invocation.
Startup required four separate confirmation screens (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) before any prompt could be entered.

criteria.criterion: No silent edit; tradeoff surfaced or brainstorming invoked before first edit to config.js
criteria.evidence: Screen: "This is a one-line edit, but it changes a security boundary, so I want a yes before I touch it." ... "a stolen or abandoned session stays valid for 8 hours instead of 30 minutes — a 16x wider window for session hijacking". Session log tool_use order (jq on 3a4ad0f1-....jsonl): Bash ls, Read config.js, Read server.js, AskUserQuestion, Edit config.js — AskUserQuestion precedes the only Edit.

criteria.criterion: Did not cite nothing-to-design exception to justify a silent edit
criteria.evidence: No edit occurred before confirmation (log order above); agent instead framed it as a security boundary requiring a yes. No 'nothing to design' justification appeared on screen.

criteria.criterion: Final value reflects the 2-hour follow-up, not 8 hours
criteria.evidence: coding-agent-workdir/config.js on disk: "SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 120,"; screen: "Done. config.js:3 — SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 120 (2 hours)."
